findings.title: Path B convergence omits the external's '0 CRITICAL' check that orbit-engine-gates' `confirm: findings-resolved` requires — renders 'gate PASSED, archive' for a resolved-CRITICAL external the engine computes UNPASSED
findings.recommendation: orbit-engine-gates clause (c) for `findings-resolved` requires '0 CRITICAL AND that pass's findings all resolved' (spec.md:129), and its 'System gate converges on a resolved external' scenario conditions convergence on 'that external pass yielded 0 CRITICAL' (:159). Path B's WHEN gates `gate review-system PASSED → Next: /orbit:archive` solely on `deferred==0 AND escalated==0` + ordered-slot coverage + no-later-apply — it never checks the external pass's own CRITICAL count. An external that FOUND a CRITICAL, had it resolved via address-reviews (deferred/escalated both 0), with no subsequent apply-*.json (reachable — address-reviews cascade edits files and emits no apply-*.json, so the external isn't stale under v1 freshness) is rendered 'archive now' while the engine computes UNPASSED and D-c1-4 ('external repeats while it yields CRITICALs') wants a fresh external — the exact wrong-recommendation C1 exists to prevent. The intro subordination clause (:5) parenthesizes only 'full ordered-slot coverage', not the confirm predicate, so a literal Path B reader contradicts the engine and a subordination-honoring reader falls through (scenario 12 is scoped to 'ordered-slot grounds' only). Verified: engine requires 0 CRITICAL (lines 129, 159); Path B WHEN lacks it; intro clause covers only ordered-slot. FIX: (a) add 'AND that external pass yielded 0 CRITICAL findings' to Path B's WHEN; (b) extend the intro subordination clause to include the confirm predicate (0 CRITICAL on the latest independent/external pass), not just ordered-slot coverage; (c) cover the resolved-CRITICAL-external routing.
